business_problem: The Danish Diabetes Association’s former CRM created bottlenecks around member data, fundraising, and outreach, which slowed service to constituents and delayed revenue collection for programming.
solution_summary: The Danish Diabetes Association replaced an expert-only legacy CRM with a tailored Dynamics 365 platform that unifies constituent service, fundraising, membership administration, and reporting. Dynamics 365 stores member and volunteer interactions, integrates with the phone system so staff can see a caller’s full relationship history, connects to Power Pages for local-branch outreach, and links to an online payment system that creates new constituent records as membership fees are paid. Dashboards and self-service reports give staff real-time visibility into campaign performance, member data gaps, and revenue generation, while address-data APIs help keep contact records current. The result is a 360-degree engagement view across national and local activity rather than disconnected membership, payment, and communication tools. That architecture lets the nonprofit tailor outreach, onboard supporters faster, and turn member and fundraising data into immediate operational action.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365
solution_components.role: Acts as the constituent CRM for member service, fundraising, dashboards, and interaction history.

solution_components.name: Power Pages
solution_components.role: Supports local-branch communication and regional outreach integrated with the CRM.

data_flow: Member, volunteer, payment, and interaction data is captured in Dynamics 365, branches use Power Pages-connected workflows for local outreach, and dashboards and reports expose campaign and revenue signals back to staff in real time.
business_outcome: The association improved member service, gained same-day fee collection, and can now tailor outreach and fundraising decisions using real-time CRM and campaign data.
